title: Air Quality Observations
description: Hourly air quality measurements delivered by partner organisations: monitoring stations, their sampling points (one pollutant each) and the time series of observations.

StationKind.description: Classification of a station by the dominant emission sources influencing it.

Pollutant.description: Air pollutant measured at a sampling point. S1 says the value is a "code from the EEA pollutant vocabulary, e.g. NO2, PM10, O3", i.e. the vocabulary's notation, not its numeric identifier (Q-002).
Pollutant.$comment: extensible code list; known values in examples

x-vocabulary.name: AQD - Air Quality Pollutants
x-vocabulary.licence: unknown (to be checked on the register)

ConcentrationUnit.description: Unit of measure of the observed values at a sampling point.
ConcentrationUnit.$comment: extensible code list; known values in examples

ObservationValidity.description: Validity flag of an observation (EEA AQD observation validity).
ObservationValidity.$comment: extensible code list; known values in examples

en.-99: Not valid due to station maintenance or calibration
en.3: Valid, but below detection limit and number replaced by 0.5*detection limit

x-vocabulary.name: AQD - Observation Validity
x-vocabulary.licence: unknown (to be checked on the register)

ObservationVerification.description: Verification status of an observation (EEA AQD observation verification).
ObservationVerification.$comment: extensible code list; known values in examples

x-vocabulary.name: AQD - Observation Verification
x-vocabulary.licence: unknown (to be checked on the register)

Position.description: Geographic position of a station. CRS is not stated in S1; WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) decimal degrees assumed (A-005). Kept as lat/lon/altitude rather than a geometry for wire compatibility (D-002).

altitude.description: Altitude of the station. Unit and vertical datum not stated in S1; metres above mean sea level assumed (A-005). S1 allows both omission and xsi:nil — meaning of the difference unclear (Q-004).

ObservationCollection.description: One delivery from a partner: a set of stations with their sampling points and observations. Root element of the exchange document.

Station.description: Air quality monitoring station at a fixed location.

id.description: Document-local identifier (xs:ID) of the station element. Only unique within one delivery and must not start with a digit; not to be used as a persistent key (Q-001).

stationCode.description: Code of the station, assumed stable across deliveries and used as the persistent identifier (A-002). Possibly the EEA/national station code (e.g. "DEBE010") — to confirm.

operator.description: Organisation operating the station (free text in S1).

stationType.description: Station classification by dominant emission source.

samplingPoints.description: Sampling points operated at a station.

SamplingPoint.description: Measurement configuration at a station for one pollutant, delivering one time series of observations in one unit.

id.description: Identifier (xs:ID) of the sampling point. S1 only makes it unique within one document; whether it is stable across deliveries is unknown (Q-001). Used as identifier provisionally.

pollutant.description: Pollutant measured, as the notation code of the EEA pollutant vocabulary (e.g. NO2).

unit.description: Unit of all observation values of this sampling point.

observations.description: Time series of observations of a sampling point.

SamplingPoint.$comment: C-002: Within one sampling point, at most one observation per interval begin (no duplicates or overlapping intervals in one delivery).

Observation.description: One aggregated measurement result of a sampling point for a time interval (normally one hour).

begin.description: Start of the averaging interval (inclusive). Must carry a UTC offset (C-003).

end.description: End of the averaging interval (exclusive assumed, A-006).

value.description: Measured value in the unit of the sampling point. xsi:nil when no value is available; the reason should then be expressed by the validity flag (C-004).

validity.description: Validity flag (EEA AQD observation validity code).

verification.description: Verification status (EEA AQD observation verification code).

Observation.$comment: C-001: The end of the interval must be after its begin.; C-003: begin and end must carry an explicit UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-23T10:00:00+01:00). S1's xs:dateTime also accepts local times without offset; such values are ambiguous.; C-004: If value is nil, validity must be a "not valid" code (-1 or -99); if validity is 1–4, value must not be nil.; C-005: Interval length is one hour for hourly data (end - begin = PT1H).
